title: Led a 33-session learning program with Philips University
summary: I designed and led a 2025 skill-building program with Philips University: 33 sessions, 492 learners, 8.9 out of 10, and I taught 23 of them.
what_would_have_happened: Engineers would pick up AI and delivery practices ad hoc, without a curriculum.
the_call: Build a curriculum with the corporate university and run it as a program.
what_i_did: Designed the courses, selected external vendors, planned the 2026 curriculum and taught most sessions myself.
what_changed: Philips University raised its funding for 2026, business teams set aside travel budget for my workshops, and the 2026 curriculum took AI as its theme.

quotes.text: He did an amazing job in conducting several PU led trainings, which were very positively rated and received by the participants, also resulting in higher funding from PU.
